- Define sets for vowels (case-sensitive) and consonants; iterate from the second-to-last character down to index 1 (exclude first and last chars). 
- For each index i, if s[i] is a vowel and both neighbors s[i-1] and s[i+1] are consonants, return s[i] immediately (closest from right due to reverse scan).
- If no such vowel is found, return empty string.
